verdict.rationale: The firm documents a dedicated Data Protection & Privacy Practice that advises on data governance, cybersecurity and privacy compliance, covering the DPDP Act 2023, GDPR/CCPA alignment and breach response, for tech, financial and start-up clients. The TMC practice separately advises on data and AI. missing for 10: in-depth first-party detail (named team, matters, privacy-specific publications), independent or hands-on corroboration of the practice's track record.
